value.rationale: The target is the canonical vertex-minimal orientable sphere-bundle triangulation. The result determines the complete vertex-support ideal of its unique nonzero second mod-two homology class, identifies every minimum support, and gives the sharp forced-surjectivity threshold. This is a structural local-to-global invariant rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
